# GRU latency check (F3.3)

CPU latency at batch size 1 on 1 thread of the final configs (configs/final/bilstm.yaml, configs/final/gru.yaml), measured in one process with oneDNN (`torch.backends.mkldnn`) enabled, the PyTorch default, and disabled. Each value is the median over 3 repeats of the mean of 200 timed forward passes after 20 warm-up passes; within each repeat both conditions are measured for each model in turn.

Environment: torch 2.14.1+cu130, oneDNN available: True, CPU AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics, Windows-11-10.0.26300-SP0.

| Model | Params | oneDNN enabled (ms) | oneDNN disabled (ms) | Disabled / enabled |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| bilstm | 138,502 | 1.570 | 6.993 | 4.45 |
| gru | 104,070 | 7.572 | 7.002 | 0.92 |

GRU / BiLSTM latency: 4.82 with oneDNN enabled, 1.00 with oneDNN disabled.

For reference, results/profile_rtx4060-laptop.csv (single process, oneDNN enabled) has bilstm 1.439 ms, gru 9.328 ms.

Every measurement is in gru_latency_check.csv.
